statement: Pinned SDL 3.2.0 Switch HIDAPI defines SPI factory stick calibration address 0x603D..0x604E, user stick calibration 0x8010..0x8025, IMU factory calibration 0x6020..0x6037 and user IMU scale 0x8026..0x8039; its code uses these for consumer normalization.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Host-read layout and fallback conventions from SDL; actual retail flash content, write persistence and physical calibration accuracy unmeasured.
